title: karti thi zainab bayaa'n bhai hassan mar gaye
body:
karti thi zainab bayaa'n bhai hassan mar gaye kyu na ho mehshar ayaa'n bhai hassan mar gaye
ho gayi ham par jafa zehr dagha se diya
qoo'n hua mu se rawaa'n bhai hassan mar gaye
peet'te hai sar hussain dil ko ho kis tarah chain
<<DIVIDER>>
baba hai na ammajaa'n bhai hassan mar gaye
sar pe na hyder rahe aur na payambar rahe
sab gaye sooe jina bhai hassan mar gaye
teer lagaane ko ab bhai ke taboot par
<<DIVIDER>>
baithe hai sab bad gumaa'n bhai hassan mar gaye
qasime ghuncha dahan rota hai wo kam suqan
usse karu kya bayaa'n bhai hassan mar gaye
ashk bahaati hu mai qaak udaati hu mai
<<DIVIDER>>
karti hu aaho fugha'n bhai hassan mar gaye
